subject.title: fix(abort): cancel active ACP detached tasks on requester stop

question: After the descendant-cascade defect is fixed, must this external PR provide real ACP process-exit evidence, or should an ACP/task-lifecycle owner grant a proof override based on source and CI evidence?
rationale: The contributor cannot produce an ACP-enabled live run in the reported environment, while repository policy makes real behavior proof a merge gate for external runtime PRs unless a maintainer explicitly overrides it.

options.title: Require live ACP proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, process-tree capture, or runtime log showing a long-running ACP child and nested descendant exit after requester stop and the ledger reaching cancelled state.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: An ACP/task-lifecycle owner may explicitly accept the focused tests and traced cancellation contract after confirming the corrected recursive behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live ACP proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, process-tree capture, or runtime log showing a long-running ACP child and nested descendant exit after requester stop and the ledger reaching cancelled state.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans owner-key task indexing, task cancellation seams, and ACP task lifecycle behavior.
